page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 6763P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage. It comes bundled with 7679 GB of local SSD storage, making it suitable for data-intensive operations that require high-capacity, low-latency local disk access. Additionally, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers.

Given the high ratio of local SSD capacity to compute resources, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require dense local storage without the overhead of external block storage. It is designed for storage-heavy and database workloads, such as relational databases, NoSQL databases, and distributed file systems, where high-capacity local SSDs and a balanced 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio are required.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.4xlarge is an x86_64 server instance designed for storage-intensive and database workloads. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, it features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon 6763P-C vCPUs running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 7679 GB of local SSD storage, which provides high-capacity local data retention and low-latency access. The instance also delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps. Lacking dedicated GPU hardware, this server is optimized for data-dense operations rather than accelerated computing. It is highly suited for running relational databases, NoSQL systems, and distributed storage platforms that benefit from massive local SSD capacity and dedicated compute resources.
